body.p: Favorable reconsideration of this Application, in light of the following discussion, is respectfully requested. Claims 1-10 were previously presented. Claim 3 has been amended, and new claim 13 has been added. Claims 1-2 have been canceled without prejudice or disclaimer. Accordingly, claims 3-10 and 13 are pending in the present Application. Applicant submits that upon entry of the present Response, claims 3-10 and 13 are in condition for allowance. Moreover, the Applicant submits that no new matter has been introduced by the foregoing amendments.

The outstanding Office Action indicates that claims 1-10 would be allowable if rewritten or amended to overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), 2nd paragraph, set forth in the Office action.

Applicant acknowledges with appreciation the indication of allowable subject matter. In response, claims 1-2 are canceled and claim 3 has been amended to incorporate limitations from claims 1-2 and to correct the noted informalities under 35 U.S.C. 112(b), as discussed below.
Accordingly, Applicant believes all pending claims are now in condition for allowance.

First, Applicant wishes to thank the Examiner for the courtesy of an interview granted to Applicant's representative on March 19, 2025, at which time the outstanding issues in this case were discussed. Arguments similar to the ones developed hereinafter were presented and the Examiner indicated that in light of the arguments, he would reconsider the outstanding grounds for rejection upon formal submission of a response.
In the outstanding Office Action, claims 1-10 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. § 112, second paragraph as being indefinite.

In response to the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. § 112, second paragraph, claim 3 is amended to correct the noted informalities. More specifically, limitations from previously presented claim 1 have been amended and subsequently incorporated into claim 3.

Regarding the "tool attachment surface" claim 3 has been amended in accordance with the description of paragraph [0017] as published, which provides the tool attachment surface 2a. Claim 3 further defines the "plate shaped flat portion" from previously presented claim 2.

In view of amended claim 3, it is believed that all pending claims are definite and no further rejection on that basis is anticipated. If, however, the Examiner disagrees, the Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned who will be happy to work with the Examiner in a joint effort to derive mutually acceptable language.

Consequently, in view of the present amendment and in light of the above discussion, the outstanding grounds of rejection are believed to have been overcome. The Application, as amended, is believed to be in condition of allowance. An early and favorable action to that effect is respectfully requested.
Maier & Maier, PLLC Christopher J. Maier
345 South Patrick Street Attorney of Record
